form.title: Head of Household Filing Status Schedule

fields.label: Name or names as shown on tax return.
Social Security Number or Individual Taxpayer Identification Number. Enter 9 digits.
Line 1 — Check one box below to identify your marital status

options.radioOption: Line 1 A. Not legally married/Registered Domestic Partnership during 2025.
options.label: 1a — Not legally married/RDP during 2025

options.radioOption: Line 1 b . Surviving spouse/Registered Domestic Partner (my spouse/Registered Domestic Partner died before 01/01/2025).
options.label: 1b — Surviving spouse/RDP (my spouse/RDP died before 01/01/2025)

options.radioOption: Line 1 c. Marriage/Registered Domestic Partnership was annulled.
options.label: 1c — Marriage/RDP was annulled

options.radioOption: Line 1 d. Received final decree of divorce, legal separation, dissolution, or termination of marriage/Registered Domestic Partnership by 12/31/2025 .
options.label: 1d — Received final decree of divorce, legal separation, dissolution, or termination of marriage/RDP by 12/31/2025

options.radioOption: Line 1 e. Legally married/Registered Domestic Partner and did not live with spouse/Registered Domestic Partner during 2025 .
options.label: 1e — Legally married/RDP and did not live with spouse/RDP during 2025

options.radioOption: Line 1 f. Legally married/Registered Domestic Partner and lived with spouse/Registered Domestic Partner during 2025 . List the beginning and ending dates for each period when you lived together.
options.label: 1f — Legally married/RDP and lived with spouse/RDP during 2025

fields.label: List the beginning FROM date as a two digit month/two digit day/four digit year.
List the ending TO date as a two digit month/two digit day/four digit year.
Second beginning date: List the second FROM date as a two digit month/two digit day/four digit year.
Second ending date: List the second ending TO date as a two digit month/two digit day/four digit year.
Line 2 — Check one box below to identify the relationship of the person that qualifies you for the head of household filing status

options.radioOption: Line 2 a. Son, daughter, stepson, or stepdaughter.
options.label: 2a — Son, daughter, stepson, or stepdaughter

options.radioOption: Line 2 b. Grandchild, brother, sister, half brother, half sister, stepbrother, stepsister, nephew, or niece.
options.label: 2b — Grandchild, brother, sister, half brother, half sister, stepbrother, stepsister, nephew, or niece

options.radioOption: Line 2 d. Father, mother, stepfather, or stepmother.
options.label: 2d — Father, mother, stepfather, or stepmother

options.radioOption: Line 2 e. Grandfather, grandmother, son-in-law, daughter-in-law, father-in-law, mother-in-law, brother-in-law, sister-in-law, uncle, or aunt.
options.label: 2e — Grandfather, grandmother, son-in-law, daughter-in-law, father-in-law, mother-in-law, brother-in-law, sister-in-law, uncle, or aunt

fields.label: Part three. Qualifying Person Information. Line 3 . First Name.
Line 3 . Social Security Number. Enter 9 digits.
Line 3 . Date of birth. Enter date as a 2 digit month/2 digit day/4 digit year. If your qualifying person is age 19 or older in 2025, go to line 3a. If not, go to line 4 .
Line 3a — Was your qualifying person a full time student under age 24 in 2025?
Line 3b — Was your qualifying person permanently and totally disabled in 2025?
Line 4 . Enter qualifying person’s gross income in 2025 . See instructions.
Line 5 . Number of days your qualifying person lived with you during 2025 . See instructions.
